notes.title: Tiny fix with 0.7.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi guys![/h1]

A very, very small issue is fixed: Now you can customize the input control for setting the mine velocity. So you may use a mouse without mouse wheel.

This is a requirement for a new feature coming soon: I want to add full controller support, as this was wished by several players. Not as easy as it should be, but you may look forward.

notes.title: Version 0.7.2 released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

After a long break (sorry!) development goes on. As promised you get some visual stuff this time, so enjoy the improved backgrounds. They look particularly impressive on a high resolutin screen.
Aside from that, there are some small changes like a custom mouse cursor and glowing rocket engines.

Have fun!

notes.title: Version 0.7.1 released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Gravinauts![/h1]

The first update includes over a dozen small changes:
[list]
[*]a lot of fixes of tiny errors concerning sound, multiplayer, challenges, and head-up display
[*]some challenges are now a little bit easier and better to understand
[*]some comfort changes like a spaceship headlight indicator
[/list]

The next update will probably contain more visual stuff, so you may look forward. And don’t forget to join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/qScSYNV]discord.gg/qScSYNV[/url], especially when you want to fight some online battles!

notes.title: Join us on Discord!
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

Frank here. I created a Discord server for meeting other players: [url=https://discord.gg/qScSYNV]discord.gg/qScSYNV[/url]

After joining you can
[list]
[*]arrange to meet others for online matches,
[*]discuss about the game, possible bugs, and desired features, and
[*]talk with former testers and the developer.
[/list]

Online matches are really much fun, so try it — but you better have trained enough before!

notes.title: New gameplay trailer
notes.notes:
It’s hard to check out a game when you only have a short trailer and some screenshots, so I released 15 minutes of gameplay:
[previewyoutube=qij-UgNDElQ;full][/previewyoutube]

You can see the menu, some challenges, and finally a complete multiplayer battle between me and a friend. The head-up display has changed a little bit meanwhile, but this video gives a good impression of the game.

notes.title: Gravity in Space is a highly unusual physics-based space shooter out in Early Access
notes.notes:
Here's your chance to try out the most unusual physics-based space action game I've ever seen. In Gravity in Space you fly around various weird maps filled with small planets, rocks and more in a tiny little spaceship you control with six degrees of freedom.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/01/gravity-in-space-is-a-highly-unusual-physics-based-space-shooter-out-in-early-access

notes.title: Gravity in Space Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
Hello Gravinauts!

Frank here. It’s been a long time since I started with development and I am glad to finally announce: Gravity in Space is out now!

This is my very first game and I have put a lot of effort into it. I hope you enjoy this mixture of rocket science and shooting and appreciate the uniqueness of the gameplay. Post your thoughts and issues to the Steam community hub, I am going to pay attention to all of your ideas.

It helps me a lot if you spread the word. You can support me this way if you like my game.

Now it’s time to have fun and to lift off!

notes.title: Gravity in Space might be the most unique (and weirdest) space shooter I've ever seen
notes.notes:
Currently in development with a release planned to happen in 2021, Gravity in Space is a fully 3D space shooter with six degrees of freedom.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/gravity-in-space-might-be-the-most-unique-and-weirdest-space-shooter-ive-ever-seen
